beats.label: S1 · The Joining
beats.text: Planes spray Albuquerque; everyone convulses and wakes as one hive mind. Carol's partner Helen dies, and Carol is one of thirteen humans immune.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the premise, Carol's grief, and the immune-versus-Others geometry the whole show turns on.

beats.label: S1 · Bilbao
beats.text: In Bilbao Carol meets the other immunes; they are content and refuse to help. Her rage triggers a mass seizure that kills many; she returns home only with her handler, Zosia.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes that Carol will have to fight alone, that her emotions are a weapon, and pairs her with Zosia.

beats.label: S1 · The rules
beats.text: Carol probes the Others: they cannot lie, cannot kill, will give her anything. She doses Zosia with truth serum to force answers and nearly stops her heart.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The constraints Carol maps here become the exact levers she pulls at season's end (asking the hive for a bomb).

beats.label: S1 · The warehouse
beats.text: Carol tracks the Others' food supply to a warehouse of human body parts. Koumba tells her the immunes voted her out, and that the Others can convert any immune who consents.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the horror underneath the utopia and plants the consent mechanism that the finale hinges on.

beats.label: S1 · Manousos walks
beats.text: Manousos, a defiant immune, crosses the Darién Gap on foot rather than accept the Others' help. Nearly killed and rescued against his will, he drives north to reach Carol.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Carol's eventual co-conspirator and shows he will pay any price to fight the hive.

beats.label: S1 · Charm offensive
beats.text: Zosia woos Carol for weeks and they sleep together. Then Zosia admits the Others are engineering Carol's custom conversion virus from her frozen eggs - ready in about a month.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Zosia into both love interest and ticking-clock threat, forcing the finale's decision.

beats.label: S1 · The bomb
beats.text: Manousos arrives and triggers a mass seizure by radio, proving Others can be killed. A Peruvian immune teen willingly joins. Carol requests an atom bomb and joins Manousos.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Weapon proven, weapon acquired, alliance formed - the exact starting position for what comes next.

cliffhanger.text: Manousos has proven the Others can be killed en masse by a specific radio frequency, and Carol has had the hive deliver her an atom bomb and told him she's in. Meanwhile the Others are roughly a month from finishing her custom conversion virus from her stolen stem cells.
questions: Will Carol actually strike, or does her bond with Zosia hold her back?
Can Manousos and Carol move before the Others finish her conversion virus?
What do Koumba and the other content immunes do when the war begins?

characters.name: Carol Sturka
characters.line: Romantasy author and grieving widow, one of thirteen humans immune to the hive-mind virus; now armed and allied with Manousos against the Others.

characters.name: Zosia
characters.line: Carol's assigned Other and now her lover, still one voice inside the hive mind that is racing to convert Carol into itself.

characters.name: Manousos
characters.line: A defiant Greek immune who trekked from Paraguay to reach Carol and has just proven a specific radio frequency can kill the Others.

characters.name: The Others
characters.line: The single hive-mind of everyone infected during the Joining; cannot lie or kill living things, subsist on human body parts, and need each immune's consent to convert them.

characters.name: Helen
characters.line: Carol's late partner, buried in Carol's yard, whose memories now live on inside the hive mind Carol is trying to destroy.

characters.name: Koumba Diabaté
characters.line: A hedonistic immune living in a Las Vegas penthouse, content with the Others' service and the one who told Carol the immunes have voted her out.

characters.name: Kusimayu
characters.line: An immune teenager in rural Peru who willingly accepted a custom conversion virus, proving the Others can turn any immune who consents.
